text:
Type: drop-leaf dining table with drawer
Use: dining, small meals; kitchen, small dining room, cottage
Style: farmhouse, traditional, rustic
Materials: solid pine with an antique stain, dark wooden drawer knob
Colors: warm medium brown pine, dark brown knob
Shape: rectangular top with two hinged drop leaves, small front drawer, turned upper legs, H-shaped stretchers below, compact when folded, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, homey, nostalgic, warm
Goes with: spindle-back wooden chairs, cream or sage walls, linen and checks; farmhouse kitchens, cottage or country dining rooms

product.name: INGATORP
product.description: Table with drop-leaves seats 2-4; makes it possible to adjust the table size according to need.
